verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a platform and client library like Hugging Face, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The pack covers inference providers, billing, CLI usage and community sentiment, none of which addresses telemetry controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
